originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&irq` is never used.

presenceCondition:
(and (= CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE false)
     (= CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN true)
     (= CONFIG_OF_IRQ false))
model:
(define-fun CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE () Bool
  false)
(define-fun CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_OF_IRQ () Bool
  false)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 6252547b8a7.c (Linux TWL4030). Dead store on 'irq' at line 12 ('int irq = *ops') inside irq_domain_add(), with TWL4030_CORE=false, IRQ_DOMAIN=true, OF_IRQ=false. Note: CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN is implicitly defined by CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE (lines 3-5); the configuration TWL4030_CORE=false && IRQ_DOMAIN=true is impossible in practice (IRQ_DOMAIN is only set via the TWL4030_CORE block in this file). The tool treats them as independent variables. irq is assigned from *ops but never used — simplification artifact; real kernel code uses irq for IRQ domain operations. The known vbdb bug (NullDereference ops when TWL4030_CORE=true && OF_IRQ=false) does not apply here because TWL4030_CORE=false means twl_probe() and its null ops are never called.
